scope: Existing Phase D four-USD ten-trial policy, exact reviewed successor release enrollment, durable Preview configuration intent, physical cleanup evidence and metadata-only owner controls
riskAnalysis: Authorization is narrowed to the existing Starter source-backed implementation. Four USD NEW exposure shares the existing five-USD ledger, never new money or released historical uncertainty. Exact source/task/review/configuration receipts precede each fresh one-use attempt. No provider I/O occurs from configuration journal controls; Work must verify actual metadata before attestation. Unknown acknowledgments and physical cleanup deny continuation.

threatModel.assets: Dedicated credentials, immutable owner records, source identity and existing testing exposure must remain isolated from models and frontend inputs.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated owner controls journal intent; trusted Work performs reviewed Vercel operations; models remain data-only and cannot attest provider metadata or grant authority.
threatModel.abuseCases: Caller-chosen IDs bypassing dedupe, forged configuration chains, rehashed receipt substitutions, duplicate dispatch after lost acknowledgments, revoked authority masking failed workspace cleanup.
threatModel.mitigations: Stable scope/source/task duplicate key, unresolved intent lock, ordered hash-bound events, exact runtime and eight-key verification, predispatch enrollment receipt equality, physical preparation/destruction journal and serial fail-closed admission.

rollback: Revert only the reviewed feature changes while preserving all historical CAS records and pending financial exposure. Keep paid flags disabled. Never reopen old approvals, modify main/Production or apply the agent patch to the real product.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Exact field and manifest validation reject extra credential keys, wrong values and malformed configuration event chains.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact source/runtime/task/owner/workspace bindings and fresh review receipts reject old approvals and substituted deployments.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing organization Redis CAS permits one claim and one operation dispatch; durable markers survive restart and lost acknowledgments.
negativePaths.cancellation: Revocation and canceled tasks cannot create model authority; physical preparation is recorded before I/O and missing destruction acknowledgment blocks continuation.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Closed attempts and revoked grants are insufficient: failed, missing or corrupt physical destruction evidence prevents new paid admission.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unknown provider acknowledgments remain unresolved; no automatic deployment or model retry is permitted. Owner status is read-only recovery.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Worker/nonowner/cross-workspace identities cannot journal, enroll, activate, impersonate reviewers or publish.
negativePaths.spending-limit: At most ten serial fresh attempts share four USD new retained exposure, also bounded by the unchanged five-USD ledger. Unknown counting charges remain pending, no provider hard-cap claim.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Incomplete configuration ACK chain cannot authorize execution. Model usage remains recorded on artifact failure; no generated-code execution or publication.

defects.rootCause: First draft duplicate key included caller IDs and trusted event order insufficiently; independent adversarial QA demonstrated bypass and integrity gaps before release.
defects.detectionGap: Configuration refresh previously relied on a local operator marker; the new controller must defend restart and changed-ID duplicates in durable owner CAS.
defects.regression: Pure configuration64, root107, native20, UI39 and Auditor82 focused checks passed; real Redis contention/restart added; full qualification pending.
defects.historicalPrevention: Old markers, receipts, approvals and the verified flaky-test repair stay unchanged; no provider mutation occurred during development.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse the existing owner controller, organization CAS, spending ledger and five-stage worker; no competing orchestration or provider gateway.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new package, external provider, infrastructure or credentials. Configuration helper is included in the source fingerprint.
proactiveReview.threats: Models cannot mutate external configuration, choose policy fields or approve spending; exact allowlist and reviewed receipt chain remain authoritative.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Lost acknowledgment, expired task, unconfirmed disposal, forged receipt, insufficient headroom or stale release stops admission before paid dispatch.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Deterministic malformed/foreign/duplicate and physical-cleanup fixtures plus real Redis contention test; no real provider requests in tests.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Auditor found and challenged duplicate, chain, provenance and physical cleanup flaws; repaired and focused tests passed.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve original failed logs and all historical accounting. Unknown operation requires actual provider readback, never blind retry.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused reviewed candidate only. Full STRICT and remote verification, actual config marker/metadata proof and fresh task activation remain mandatory before paid execution.
